description: One shared function derives inReplyTo, references and threadId from a case-insensitive header map plus an optional provider conversation id, extracting Message-IDs with extractMessageIds.
GmailAdapter.getMessageDetails returns inReplyTo, references and threadId from the shared function, with no extra Gmail API call and with x-resolved-*/x-list-* headers still stripped.

MicrosoftGraphAdapter.getMessageDetails and the IMAP parsed-MIME builder derive the three fields through the shared function; existing Microsoft conversationId and IMAP threadId behaviour is preserved for stored tickets.

The Gmail threadId value is chosen from a trace of resolveReplyTargetFromProviderThreadId, findTicketByEmailThread and tickets.email_metadata, so a second message in the same conversation finds the ticket the first one created.

A Gmail reply with no reply token whose In-Reply-To names a stored rfc_message_id attaches to that ticket, and threading.originalMessageIdCandidate is the normalized In-Reply-To rather than the Gmail API id.
The unused GmailAdapter copies under server/src and packages/integrations are deleted if no live path imports them, otherwise moved onto the shared function.
